verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official OAuth-gated MCP server and an agent-mode CLI. Both expose transaction reads and writes: the MCP scopes include transactions:read/write and accounting:read/write, and the CLI offers transactions list/edit/missing/flag-missing/memo-suggestions. Agents can also load accounting and tracking categories and edit or approve transactions, with every write logged to the audit trail. That covers the pull → propose → push-coding loop, backed by the Transactions API and OpenAPI. Missing for 10: an explicit filter for transactions lacking GL/accounting codes (documented 'missing' covers receipts/memos), documented agent-raised policy-violation flags, a staged 'submit coding for human review' flow distinct from direct edits, and hands-on corroboration of coding write-back.
